fields.description: E.g. https://api.digitax.tech/ke/v2
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Last 4 characters of the stored key, so two companies sharing a key are visible at a glance.
fields.label: API Key Fingerprint

fields.description: Appended to this company's callback URL so DigiTax callbacks can be attributed to a company. Generated automatically when blank.
fields.label: Callback Token

fields.description: Default: 5
fields.label: Max Retry Attempts

fields.description: Every Invoice line Item must have Digitax Item Name; DigiTax receives that name only (never ERP item name).
fields.label: Require Digitax Item Name

fields.description: Blocks sending unless Item is already synced
fields.label: Require Manual Item Sync

fields.description: Role to Send and View Virtual Amendments
fields.label: Send Role

fields.description: Optional. Only useful when most of this company's Digitax Items share the same codes - e.g. a school where every item is a fee. Any value set here is copied into a Digitax Item's empty fields when the item is created or saved; the item can still be changed afterwards. Leave all of these blank to make every Digitax Item carry its own codes (the form will then require them).
fields.label: Default Item Settings

fields.description: KRA item classification code (e.g. 99020000). Fills a Digitax Item's Item Class Code when empty. Also used for invoice lines sent without a Digitax Item (only possible with Require Digitax Item Name off) - such sends are blocked if this is blank.
fields.label: Default Item Class Code

fields.description: KRA item type code (1 = raw material, 2 = finished product, 3 = service). Fills a Digitax Item's Item Type Code when empty.
fields.label: Default Item Type Code

fields.description: KRA tax type (A = exempt, B = 16% VAT, C = 0%, D = non-VAT, E = 8%). Fills a Digitax Item's Tax Type Code when empty. Also used for invoice lines sent without a Digitax Item - such sends are blocked if this is blank.
fields.label: Default Item Tax Type Code

fields.description: Fills a Digitax Item's Item Bar Code when empty (e.g. SCHOOL_FEES). DigiTax needs a barcode on every invoice line; sends always use the one stored on the item.
fields.label: Default Item Bar Code

fields.description: Country the item originates from, as a 2-letter code (e.g. KE). Fills a Digitax Item's Origin Nation Code when empty.
fields.label: Default Origin Nation Code

fields.description: KRA packaging unit code (e.g. NT = no packaging). Fills a Digitax Item's Package Unit Code when empty.
fields.label: Default Package Unit Code

fields.description: KRA quantity unit code (e.g. U = unit/piece). Fills a Digitax Item's Quantity Unit Code when empty.
fields.label: Default Quantity Unit Code

fields.description: Codes DigiTax/KRA require on every filing. The read-only ones are fixed by DigiTax's own code lists and are the same for every company; only the Payment Type Code is a per-company choice.
fields.label: Invoice Status Codes

fields.description: Fixed: 02 = Approved. Sent as invoice_status_code on every sale - the only valid status for a new, final sale (DigiTax has no way to change a sale's status afterwards; corrections go through credit notes).
fields.label: Submitted Invoice Status Code

fields.description: Fixed: S = Sale. Sent on sales; DigiTax marks this field deprecated and ignores it (it tells sales and credit notes apart by endpoint).
fields.label: Receipt Type Code

fields.description: Fixed: 04 = Canceled. Only chosen for an invoice that is not submitted, which the normal send paths never send.
fields.label: Cancelled Invoice Status Code

fields.description: How customers pay, as KRA records it on every sale: 01 Cash, 02 Credit (invoice now, pay later), 03 Cash/Credit, 04 Bank cheque, 05 Card, 06 Mobile money, 07 Other. One code applies to all of this company's sales.
fields.label: Default Payment Type Code
